title: Michael T. Ringwood
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Rosalie Nelson 1982, Jordon River Utah Temple; five children
VP, the Huntsman Corporation; President of Bear Creek Foods; President and CFO of Packsize LLC. Board of Advisors for BYU School of Accountancy
Bishop, High Councilor, High Priests Group Leader, Scoutmaster, Stake President
President of the Korea Seoul West Mission
First Quorum of the Seventy 2009 - present
